subject: mathematics
content: If $ 24 \int\limits_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} \bigg[\sin \left| 4x - \frac{\pi}{12} \right| + [2 \sin x] \bigg] dx = 2\pi + \alpha $, where $[\cdot]$ denotes the greatest integer function, then $\alpha$ is equal to ________.
